summary: Full backend + frontend testing of Join Requests feature (Option C). All 15 backend tests PASS, all 8 frontend scenarios PASS. Backend: GET join-requests, POST approve, POST reject endpoints verified with auth/permission checks. Frontend: owner badge visible, participants modal with Demandes en attente, inline notifications Accept/Refuse, and approve flow with badge disappearance all working correctly.
action_items: Minor code quality: In tagpoint_routes.py `_fetch_is_participant` (GET /tag-points/{id}), the SQL query does NOT filter by status='accepted'. This means invited/pending users are treated as members (isMember=true, canParticipate=true, can see group/message buttons). Example: mbenali (status='invited') sees 'Quitter' button and group access. Recommend adding AND status='accepted' to that EXISTS query.
critical_code_review_comments: tagpoint_routes.py L499: `_fetch_is_participant` query missing `AND status='accepted'` filter — invited and pending users are shown as full members with access to group chat, Je participe button, and Quitter action. This could allow a pending user to 'leave' which would delete their pending record, or an invited user to participate in sessions.

notifications.tsx L137: Inline Accept button uses testID=`approve-request-${item.id}` (notification ID), not user_id. This is consistent with how the data is structured but different from the participants modal testID format. Not a bug, just inconsistency between two components.

tagpoint_routes.py reject endpoint L1184: `if tp['user_id'] != user['user_id'] and user.get('role') != 'admin'` — only owner OR admin can reject. Members with members_approval mode cannot reject (only approve). This is by design per spec but should be documented clearly.
seed_data_creation: user_demo003 (Camille Durand) pending record restored to status='pending' after approve tests via DB UPSERT. Final state: user_demo003 status=pending for pt_demo001.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Join Requests (Option C) feature fully tested and working. pt_demo001 has join_mode=members_approval, visibility=public. user_demo003 (Camille Durand) has status=pending — manually inserted seed data. Key test paths: (1) owner sees pending badge on membres chip, (2) participants modal shows Demandes en attente with Accepter+Refuser for owner, only Accepter for member, (3) Notifications tab has inline Accepter/Refuser for join_request type, (4) non-owner non-accepted user (mbenali, invited) does NOT see badge. One minor concern: _fetch_is_participant in GET /tag-points/{id} doesn't filter by status='accepted' so invited users appear as full members in the frontend.
